verdict.rationale: Swell's features page documents CSV import and export of products, including categories, which covers the bulk import/export core of the story. A backend products API with official Node and PHP libraries exists, but nothing in the pack shows bulk or batch API operations or a dedicated bulk-edit tool. Missing for 10: documented bulk-edit capability (in-dashboard or via CSV re-import updates), bulk/batch API endpoints, in-depth CSV format docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, I can bulk import, export, and edit the catalog — CSV or API — without touching products one at a time

citations.quote: Seamlessly import or export products from CSV files, including product categories.
Official libraries for the Swell API are available for Node and PHP.
